_comment: 2-way shard split for the Mocha suite (#231, docs/design/191-test-parallelization.md §2). Rule: shard-1 pins the top-N heaviest files by CI wall-clock, with N chosen to land ≤1.2× drift between shards; shard-2 is 'everything else' via Mocha --ignore. Currently N=8. The session-phase-machine split (#233) produced three files: session-phase-detach (~48s) + session-phase-claim (~22s) + session-phase-processing (~30s) — all three pinned here. session-phase-processing was originally placed in shard-2 (#233) because it was the lightest of the trio, but shard-2 has crept up since then; rebalanced into shard-1 in PR #391's drift-gate fix. Other heavy pins: outbox (~42s), scheduler (~41s). Lightweight files in shard-1 (mock-adapter-claim-heartbeat ~3s from #382, mock-adapter-silent-chaos from #340-followup PR-3) are here despite size to keep shard-2's pre-existing heavy tests (adapter-claude-code-lifecycle-v2, pause-resume) from being pushed over their per-test timeouts under CI runner contention. adapter-reconnect (~12s, next-heaviest in shard-2 not flagged as timeout-sensitive) was promoted from shard-2 in #334 PR-1 when 13 new player-state tests added to shard-2 tipped drift to 1.202× over the 1.2× bound; the move lands the projected ratio at ~1.07×. stages.test.ts promoted from shard-2 in the post-#784 rebalance: #784's 4 reconciliation tests tipped drift to 1.235x (shard-1 avg 252.0s vs shard-2 311.3s); moving stages (~20s) lands the projected ratio at ~1.07x, leaving headroom for #774's chat-gate + #775's daemon-ghost suites landing in shard-2. force-detach-recheck.test.ts promoted into shard-1 in the #810 (G2 pair) drift fix: its two 30s-timeout gated-activity integration tests defaulted into shard-2 and tipped drift to 1.203x; pinning it here lands the projected ratio back under the bound (the pin is about the timeout class, not raw weight — same rationale as the mock-adapter pins). upgrade-to-2.test.ts pinned in #785: a new heavyweight cutover-engine suite (5 full worker+workflow-lifecycle integration tests — session/scheduler/global-maestro spin-up per case); defaulting it into shard-2 (already the heavier shard post-#784) would tip drift over 1.2x, so it lands in shard-1 to keep the shards balanced (~1.08x projected). Rebalance procedure + 20% drift bound lives in test/README.md; derivation + historical rationale in the design doc §2.
